name: Gossips brought by the Mirror
source:
Moon Life: A hundred million years after the destruction of Earth, the landform of the natural satellites molded, reformed, and created a new lifeform from their soil. From that moment, a new civilization started.

A citizen of Titan, Gavin--also a spacecraft designer--has given up hope in life with the past recent days being terrible. He lost his lover, his friends, his job, and his sense of self. His brother calls him after 12 years, and Gavin is given a chance to mend their damaged relationship. Together, they voyage to the moon, Tethys, and meet up with... Gavin from a different universe...

[From [url=https://peridon.itch.io/gossips-brought-by-the-mirror]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
月球生命：地球毁灭一亿年后，天然卫星的地貌被塑造、改造，并从它们的土壤中创造了一种新的生命形式。从那一刻起，一个新的文明开始了。

加文是土卫六的公民，也是一名航天器设计师，他对生活失去了希望，最近几天的日子很糟糕。他失去了爱人、朋友、工作和自我意识。12年后，他的哥哥给他打电话，加文得到了修复他们受损关系的机会。他们一起航行到月球特提斯，并遇见了……来自不同宇宙的加文……

[来自[url=https://peridon.itch.io/gossips-brought-by-the-mirror]Itch.io[/url]]
